subject: How to get the gene list from diff.bedgraph from methylKit

messages.author: cbaf432548852c3b
messages.subject: How to get the gene list from diff.bedgraph from methylKit
parts:
Dear Dr Altuna,

Good day to you. I performed the analysis using methylKit and I have a diff.bedgraph as example shown below:

track type=bedGraph name='Example_diff.bedgraph' description='meth.diff' visibility=full color=255,0,255 altColor=102,205,170 maxHeightPixels=80:80:11 
chr1    626751    626752    30.8390480032271
chr1    626773    626774    27.9767142760441
chr1    626792    626793    27.8023272941523

May I know how to convert this diff.bedgraph to gene list? It is because I want to perform downstream enrichment analysis using DAVID etc..

Kindly please help. Thanks for your time.

Best wishes,
Wai Feng

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] How to get the gene list from diff.bedgraph from methylKit
parts: you can try great.stanford.edu to associate differentially methylated CpGs to genes, it will also do the gene set analysis automatically. You can also use the R package for  GREAT to do the same thing.
